creative_direction.name: Verdigris Felt Spotlight Monument
creative_direction.brief: A tactile photographic cyclorama: deep verdigris wool felt sweeps from wall into a continuous felt ground with no visible seam, one soft elliptical spotlight pool falling behind the upper zone so the pile glows gently around the silhouette. The cutout rests low-right at its true base line, contact shadow absorbed by the pile at toe and heel tips, while a compact Baskerville monument sits in the calm upper-left felt: brand line above, name below, ending well above the cap so the grid stays upper-left weighted against the lower-right subject. Felt pile swallows light; the lacquered red and gold heel own every highlight.
creative_direction.material: deep verdigris wool felt cyclorama with soft pile
creative_direction.lighting: one soft elliptical spotlight pool from upper front on felt, otherwise gentle diffuse ambient, no hard shadows
